title: methodRegions needs filtered compact output for very long methods
wanted_capability: analysis.methodRegions should support a compact/filter mode that can search or rank regions by preview text, captures, live-outs, field touches, listener/lambda count, or line window without dumping every top-level statement into context.
fallback_used: Probe read harness dump files and bounded source ranges to sift a 178-region long-method report.
